questions.scenario: A web app must back up its files, configuration and linked Azure SQL database every day. Backups must be retained for 60 days and must be downloadable.
questions.question: What should you configure?

options.text: A custom backup with a daily schedule and 60-day retention to a blob container in a storage account
options.why: Correct. Custom backups support a schedule, retention, linked databases and downloadable files.

options.text: Automatic backups
options.why: Automatic backups are hourly, retained for 30 days and cannot be downloaded.

options.text: A deployment slot named backup
options.why: A slot is a live copy of the app, not a backup with retention.

options.text: An Azure Files share mounted to the app
options.why: Mounting storage does not create backups of the app or database.

questions.explanation: Custom backups go to a storage account in the same subscription through a SAS URL and can be up to 10 GB.

questions.question: A web app must connect to an Azure SQL database that is reachable only through a private endpoint in a virtual network. What should you configure on the web app?

options.text: Virtual network integration with a dedicated subnet in the virtual network
options.why: Correct. VNet integration routes the app's outbound traffic into the virtual network.

options.text: A private endpoint for the web app
options.why: A private endpoint provides private inbound access to the app. It does not route the app's outbound calls.

options.text: An access restriction that allows the database IP address
options.why: Access restrictions filter inbound traffic to the app.

options.text: A custom domain
options.why: Custom domains do not affect outbound network connectivity.

questions.explanation: The integration subnet must be empty, /28 or larger, and delegated to Microsoft.Web/serverFarms.

questions.scenario: You configure an access restriction on a web app with the following rule: priority 100, action Allow, source 203.0.113.0/24. No other rules exist.
questions.question: What happens to a request from 198.51.100.10?

options.text: The request is denied with HTTP 403
options.why: Correct. Once an Allow rule exists, unmatched traffic is denied.

options.text: The request is allowed because no Deny rule exists
options.why: Unmatched requests are denied after any Allow rule is added.

options.text: The request is redirected to HTTPS
options.why: Redirection is controlled by HTTPS Only, not by access restrictions.

options.text: The request is queued until an administrator approves it
options.why: Access restrictions allow or deny requests immediately.

questions.explanation: Rules are evaluated by priority, lowest number first, and unmatched traffic falls through to the deny action.

questions.question: You need to ensure that a web app is reachable only from a virtual network and has no public inbound access. What should you do?

options.text: Create a private endpoint for the web app and disable public network access
options.why: Correct. A private endpoint provides a private IP address, and disabling public access removes the public entry point.

options.text: Configure virtual network integration
options.why: VNet integration affects outbound traffic only.

options.text: Add a hybrid connection
options.why: Hybrid connections provide outbound access to an on-premises host and port.

options.text: Set Minimum Inbound TLS Version to 1.3
options.why: The TLS version does not restrict which networks can reach the app.

questions.explanation: Link a private DNS zone for privatelink.azurewebsites.net so clients resolve the app to its private IP address.

questions.question: You configure virtual network integration for a web app. Which two requirements must the integration subnet meet? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

options.text: The subnet is delegated to Microsoft.Web/serverFarms
options.why: Correct. The integration subnet must be delegated to App Service.

options.text: The subnet is /28 or larger and is not used by other resources
options.why: Correct. The subnet must be empty and large enough for the plan's instances.

options.text: The subnet is named AppServiceSubnet
options.why: No specific subnet name is required.

options.text: The subnet contains a VPN gateway
options.why: A gateway is not required for regional VNet integration.

questions.explanation: A /26 subnet is recommended so that the plan can scale out.
